name: Siefeldin Sobih
intro: Hi, you can call me Saif. I enjoy understanding how tools work and developing ones that use math and logically sound algorithms to solve data problems. I have 4+ years of research experience as a data scientist and bioinformatician, including developing linear mixed-effects models for biological data.
bio: I’m a PhD student in Statistics and Data Science at Utah State University. I enjoy understanding how tools work and developing ones that use math and logically sound algorithms to solve data problems. My 4+ years of research experience span data science and bioinformatics, including linear mixed-effects models, regression, and reproducible analysis workflows. I now work on swarm robotics, integrating vision-language models into SLAM algorithms.
